title: Data Sources and Data Management in Bioinformatics
description: An introduction to the different types of data generated for bioinformatics analyses and data management principles required for scientific rigor and reproducibility. Data sources include, but are not limited to, sequencing data, 'omics data (e.g., proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics), imaging data, and clinical data. Data organization will cover topics such as management and curation of metadata, downloading data from and submitting data to public repositories, and using databases versus spreadsheets and tables.
